s: 2 weeks ago - The unit of energy in the International System of Units (SI) is the joule (J). The internal energy relative to the mass with unit J/kg is the specific internal energy. The internal energy of a system depends on its entropy S, its volume V and its number of massive particles: U(S,V,{Nj}).

s: Heat transfer is energy transfer. Adding a quantity of heat Q to a system, without doing any work during the process, will increase the internal energy by an amount equal to Q. That is, ΔU = Q. When a system does work W by expanding against its surroundings and no heat is added during the process, energy leaves the system and the internal energy decreases.
